title: Captain Vane's 'Smugglers' Road' quest sends the player to find 'Rook, at the Rope Larder' in Thornwold's deep wood. After visiting 9 distinct wood rooms (Wood's Edge, Fox Crossing, Heartwood Hollow, Root Tangle, Listening Break, Silent Reach, Waiting Bough, Gallows Glade, Fallen Muster) neither Rook nor a 'Rope Larder' ever turned up, and no room's exit list named them as a direction. Had to abandon the thread.
